libs.note: BH-5354.0 (BH-5366). The suite ledger: bin/suite-reuse.sh plan asks the harness-jobs worker (POST /api/suite-results/lookup) which suites already went green at the same input fingerprint, and record writes each result back (PUT /api/suite-results). The SERVER reads both settings rows (worker/jobs/src/lib/suite-results.js readReuseKnobs); a bad value turns reuse off, never back to the default. No runner calls the helper yet. Doc: docs/notes/2026-10-08-BH-5354-suite-reuse.md.

knobs.note: on|off; off = every suite runs. The settings row lib.suite-reuse.suite_reuse is read by the worker on every lookup; the env SUITE_REUSE=off makes bin/suite-reuse.sh plan skip the lookup on this runner alone. Any other value of either is off. Recording is not affected, so turning reuse back on finds a warm ledger.

The oldest green a lookup will reuse, measured on the worker's clock from the latest ok write. Read by the worker from the settings row lib.suite-reuse.suite_reuse_max_age_h; a value outside 1..720 or not an integer turns reuse off.
